title: EFC — Hypothesis: Interrelation Between Energy and Entropy
abstract: Presents the hypothesis that energy flow and entropy gradients are interdependent components of a unified thermodynamic field. Outlines how their interaction shapes structure, dynamics, information propagation, and spacetime behaviour within the EFC framework.
key_results: Energy flow and entropy gradients form a unified thermodynamic field
Information propagation bounded by entropy production rate
Spacetime behaviour emerges from energy-entropy coupling
